headline: Darkseid forms a multiversal evil Justice League
post:
Darkseid has officially assembled a terrifying new superhuman army, according to Screen Rant. After leaving behind mortal limits to become a multiversal god, the villain has traveled to Earth-3 to draft the Crime Syndicate into his service. This twisted roster features formidable heavyweights like Ultraman, Owlman, Superwoman, Johnny Quick, and Power Ring. 

That is not even the half of it. The God of Evil has also enlisted Pandora as his harbinger to recruit across realities, alongside an alliance with a massive, powered-up Brainiac. According to the publication, the archvillain ultimately surrounds himself with captured variants of Superman stored in tanks, demanding they join him or face consumption.

Which member of this dark roster shocks you the most?

#Darkseid #JusticeLeague #DCComics
original_title: Darkseid Unveils His Justice League, All Members And Powers

headline: Justice League Unlimited: Imperiex returns after 25 years
post:
Get ready for a massive cosmic showdown because a legendary foe is officially making a comeback. According to Screen Rant, solicits for "Justice League Unlimited #28" tease the return of Imperiex, the primordial embodiment of entropy, over twenty-five years after his initial appearance. 

The cover art showcases the imposing armor of this immensely powerful villain behind DC's Trinity. The League plans to move their battlefield to New Genesis to avoid war ravaging Earth, but they instead find the area overrun by deadly alien invaders serving an unknown master. With a scale vast enough to generate his own Big Bangs, this enemy poses a terrifying challenge.

While Superman previously defeated this threat alongside surprising allies like Darkseid and Lex Luthor, a similar turnout seems unlikely this time around. Even so, the Man of Steel will surely be right at the forefront of the fight alongside other heroes like Orion.

Are you excited for this massive comic event? 🪐

#JusticeLeague #Superman #DCComics
original_title: After 25 Years, Superman's Strongest Villain Is Officially Back
